scripts/binary_inventory.py

Python · Tier B

Inspect staged native binaries and record host compatibility facts.

Usage

native_inventory reads a completed runtime image during packaging.

Inputs

Image root containing ELF, Mach-O or PE files and the current build host metadata.

Side effects

Reads file signatures and ELF GLIBC symbol versions; returns a manifest fragment without importing staged packages, executing binaries or modifying the image.

Cleanup

No persistent resources or subprocesses; the builder owns the image and manifest.
